original.target_description: Study 3: independent-samples t-test of cynical distrust after recalling disrespect versus guilt, two between-subjects conditions; final participant sample.

n.quote: A sample of 232 American adults were recruited on an electronic job-sourcing site, ... Prolific, in exchange for a small payment. Nine participants failed an attention check (see ... below) and were removed, resulting in a final sample of 223 ... Cynicism. An independent sample t-test showed that participants in the disrespect ... control condition (M=3.40, SD=1.22), t(221)=2.95, p = .004, d=.40.
